text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Are you shopping for
something
too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While out buying some pastries, I spot
Winning
Ticket and Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uh huh! Me and Yuki are here to get
some
'grammable pastries!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, sorry, Tickezo's just
accompanying me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I told her about these pastries I
wanna get,
she suggested we go
together.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Cause if Yuki's interested in them,
they've gotta
be good!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's find some photogenic
pastries!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to go shopping
together.
However, the further we go
inside...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
W-wow, this sure is a pastry hot spot...
There're
so many folks around!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The shop we want is... Oh no, it's way in
the
back... What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hnnghh... Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The other day, Hayahide said, "If you
think
logically, nothing is impossible." So
let's think
logically!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Logically? How do we do that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uh... Um... Well!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ummm... Hnngh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's it—a strategy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But how? What do we do, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Studying the crowd, I can think of a few

methods...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
There we go! Let's hurry and zoom right
through
everyone!
choice_data_list: 早足でどんどん追い抜いていこう
人の流れを見極めて進んでいこう
人混みがなくなるのを待とう
choice_data_list_en: Let's pick up the pace and pass right by them!
Let's read the flow of the crowd and make our way through.
Let's wait for the crowd to clear out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We squeeze past wherever there's an
opening,
but the dense crowd doesn't
allow us to make
much progress.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I don't feel like we're gett'n
through at all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yuki, Trainer, this way! Around the
corner!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I found the shop! This is it, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Yup, that's the one! I'll go buy
some!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket showed surprising speed
making
her way through, so I ask how
she did it...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe because it's just like when
I'm
running a race?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Like, during a race when I think, "Okay,
time to
speed up!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No matter how packed the front is, I put
all my
energy into that one push!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Winning Ticket has a good trick
up her
sleeve to move forward in tight
situations.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You got them? Woohoo! Pastries!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! ♪ It's all thanks to the two
of you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know, how 'bout after this, we eat
'em
togeth'r? I just have to repay you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Can we? Aww, Yuki, you're so... so kiiiind! Sob!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
There we go! We'll follow the flow and
gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moving with the crowd, we proceed
straight
ahead, then start curving,
gradually losing sight
of our destination.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where was that shop again... This
way? Or
over there?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You two, this way! Look, that's the
shop's sign!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, it is! I'll go buy some!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket was able to move
through the
crowd without losing her
sense of direction, so I
ask her how she
did it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe it's just like when I'm
running a race?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
During a race, you kinda gotta decide
for
yourself when the critical moment to
move is.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's weird, but when it happens, I don't
feel lost
anymore and can just shoot
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Winning Ticket has a good trick
up her
sleeve to make the most of
critical moments.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You got them? Woohoo! Pastries!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! ♪ It's all thanks to the two
of you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know, how 'bout after this, we eat
'em
togeth'r? I just have to repay you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Can we? Aww, Yuki, you're so... so kiiiind! Sob!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Got it! If we wait a while, there'll be less
people,
and we'll be able to get there
super easy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Say, Yuki, the ones you want are the
'grammable
pastries, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But, um, what does 'grammable mean?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Jordan says that all the time too, so I've
always
wondered what it means... Like,
pastries your
Gramma would like?
Maybe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I hardly know myself, but city girls use it
when
someth'n looks peachy on the
social media!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Peachy, huh? Ah, so when it looks nice
in
pictures, it looks 'grammable? I see!
Yuki, you're
so smart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While they chat, the crowd slowly
begins to thin
out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's getting emptier! Maybe this is
the right
time to go buy your pastries!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll go get some!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You got them? Woohoo! Pastries!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! ♪ It's all thanks to the two
of you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know, how 'bout after this, we eat
'em
togeth'r? I just have to repay you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Can we? Aww, Yuki, you're so... so kiiiind! Sob!
